name: Rotating random-sequenced field, 20 min (control arm, Tsang 2009 mood study)
summary: The continuous random-sequence arm of Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2009: a 1 uT field of random point values (3 ms each), passed through four left-right pairs of coils in boxes over the temporal lobes, 0.5 s per pair, 20 min once a week for 3 weeks. The paper reports mood scores like those of a sham field for it, while the same sequence given once every 3 s lowered depression scores as burst-firing did.
notes: Tsang 2009: 32 people in 8 groups of four got one of 7 field configurations or a sham field, 20 min once a week for 3 weeks, with 5 min of baseline before and after (p.1-3 [365-367]). Two boxes on a headphone frame sat over the temporal regions, four solenoids each; one left and one right solenoid were connected, and each pair got the signal for 0.5 s, 2 s per cycle (p.3 [367]). 'A single random sequence', 'extracted from a random number generator', 'was repeated continuously or once every 3,000 ms': arms 6 and 7 of Table 1, both with 3-ms points (p.4 [368]). Its length is not given. This program is arm 6, the continuous one. One left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The generator here draws a fresh value for every 3-ms point and never repeats, where the paper repeated one fixed sequence. The paper gives 1 uT and does not say where it was measured (p.1 [365]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT the scalp gets about 24 uT. Scores after/before for this arm: depression 0.97 and fatigue 1.02, like sham (1.00 and 1.08). The same sequence given once every 3 s lowered depression scores (0.92), as burst-firing did (Table 3 p.6 [370]), so only the continuous version behaved like a control. Four people per group, post hoc tests at p < .10 (p.6 [370]), single lab, never independently replicated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not a treatment for low mood or depression. Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated, eyes closed, in a quiet, dim room. The study had 5 min of baseline before and 5 min after the 20-min field. Fill in the same mood questionnaire (the study used the Profile of Mood States) before and after each session.
schedule: 20 min once a week for 3 weeks. This is the control arm: run it blinded against the burst-firing and LTP arms and against the sham program.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2009, Electromagn Biol Med 28:365 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017627/ ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785 (ring order and the '20+2' notation) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Lehman 2016, PhD thesis, Laurentian University, pp. 56-57 (CCW standard, 1-5 uT inside each solenoid) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/e809389f-805c-4414-8177-d0bf8d7127bb ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
